exact integer string (ADR-008 — never a JSON number). For CASH, the
EXACT amount being settled — never the cash-rounded figure, which the
server derives from `tenderedAmountMinor` and the order's pinned

record of the already-completed EXTERNAL terminal transaction — never a

amountMinor.description:
Positive integer minor units, as an exact string (ADR-008: money is never
a JSON number). The movement TYPE (the route) supplies the sign — a
client can never submit a negative amount.

effectiveFrom.description:
R-3(a)/C-2. Omitted = effective immediately (resolved to DATABASE time,
never this process's clock). Supplied = an explicit future activation
instant; a past instant is rejected (C-2 - enforced by the DB CHECK, not
merely this validator).

varianceApprovalExpirySeconds.description: R-4(a): configured positive duration. No default exists anywhere.

varianceToleranceMinorUnits.description:
R-1(a): absolute non-negative minor units, as an exact integer string.
A JSON number is IEEE-754 and money must never pass through one
(ADR-008) - mirrors `OpenCashSessionDto.openingFloat` exactly, including
zero being a VALID tolerance (unlike a positive-amount field).

orderTypes.description: FR-MNU-002. Vocabulary owned by Sales; stored as text (no Sales dependency).

null` (no non-heuristic source data could classify them; see the
catalogue-modifier-kind migration header), but every NEW modifier
created through this API must state its semantic kind explicitly.

recipeDelta.description: FR-MNU-013: opaque JSON — Production Spec is not implemented.

stockItemId.description: FR-MNU-012: recorded only — Inventory is out of scope.

FR-OFF-015 — the ULID the device already assigned. Preserved exactly, so an
order created offline keeps one identity for its whole life.

openedByEmployeeId.description: Optional for a PIN session, where the employee comes from the token.

originDeviceTime.description:

`origin_device_time`; it never decides the business day.

terminalId.description:
The terminal the sale is on. Optional for a terminal-bound session, where
it is taken from the token; when supplied it must MATCH the bound terminal.

effectiveFrom.description:
D-17-08 Q2 — INFORMATIONAL ONLY. Accepted, stored and returned. It is
never read by publish, resolution or any selection predicate.

closeAttemptId.description: FR-OFF-015 — the device's permanent ULID for this close attempt. REQUIRED.

countedTotalMinorUnits.description: Non-negative integer minor units, as an exact string. Zero is valid.

denominationMinorUnits.description: Positive integer minor units, as an exact string (never a JSON number).

ErrorResponse.description: Nest's default HttpException envelope, also used verbatim by the single global SalesDomainExceptionFilter (statusCode/message differ, error is the class's HTTP reason phrase or domain error name). error is sometimes absent — a bare `new UnauthorizedException()` with no message omits it.

message.description: A single message, or one entry per failed validation constraint (ValidationPipe).

approvalDecisionId.description: FR-OFF-015 — client-generated permanent id for THIS approval decision.

approvalRequestId.description: FR-OFF-015 — client-generated permanent id for THIS approval request.

managerEmployeeCode.description: The deciding manager's employee code — mirrors `PinLoginDto`.

managerPin.description: FR-SEC-020: 4-8 digits. Never logged, never echoed.

quantity.description: 6-dp decimal string. Required for `add`; forbidden for `remove_all`.

subRecipeId.description: LOGICAL recipe identity — resolved to its published version at capture time.

cashSessionId.description: FR-OFF-015 — the ULID the device assigned to the session. Preserved exactly.

notes.description: Optional free-text note recorded with the opening.

openingFloat.description:
Declared opening float in MINOR UNITS, as an exact integer string.

A string, not a number: a JSON number is IEEE-754 and money must never pass
through one (ADR-008). "50000" is 500.00 in a 2-decimal currency; the
currency itself comes from the branch, never from here.

shiftId.description: FR-OFF-015 — the ULID the device assigned to the shift. Preserved exactly.

requiresApproval.description: B-2: caller-supplied approval gate; Inventory never evaluates a threshold.

employeeCode.description: Employee code, not an email — a POS operator identifies by staff code.

pin.description: FR-SEC-020: 4–8 digits. Never logged, never echoed.

subRecipeId.description: A sub-recipe component references LOGICAL RECIPE IDENTITY, not a version.

unitId.description: MUST be a real `inventory.uom` id; Production Spec never creates UOMs.

deviceId.description: Must equal the authenticated terminal. A mismatch is 403, not a hint.

lastServerCursor.description: Opaque to the client; `null` on a first sync. D4-2 gives it meaning.

actorEmployeeId.description:
Per-OPERATION, not per-batch: a 72-hour batch spans shift changes
(`UC-OFF-01` step 8), and a batch-level actor would attribute a whole
outage to one employee.

causedBy.description:
`FR-OFF-022` — the opId of the causal parent. A child whose parent has not
been applied is DEFERRED, never rejected.

entityId.description: The aggregate this operation concerns. Never reassigned (`FR-OFF-015`).

hlc.description: `FR-OFF-041`. Stored verbatim; the server never rewrites it.

occurredAt.description:
The DEVICE's wall clock, preserved alongside the server's receipt time
(`FR-OFF-042`). Distinct from `hlc`: one is causal, one is what the receipt
says.

opId.description:
`FR-OFF-021` / SRS §21.5.1 — "idempotency key for the operation". There is
no separate idempotency field: `opId` IS it.

payload.description: Handler-specific. Validated by the registered handler, not here.

schemaVersion.description: Payload shape version for THIS operation type.

taxClassId.description: C-04: recorded only. Fiscal is out of scope, so this is never resolved.

reasonCodeId.description:
REQUIRED. FR-POS-013 demands a reason on a void, and the database agrees:
`ck_order_line_void_reason` refuses a voided row without one. Making it
optional here would only move the failure from a 400 to a 500.

The reason catalogue is `inventory.reason_codes`; this references one by id
and the service checks it is visible to the tenant.

post.summary:
Open a cashier shift and its cash session — FR-POS-090, FR-FIN-001/002.

ONE command for the cashier, two records for the model. FR-POS-090
describes a single action ("open a shift, declaring an opening float"), and
the cashier should not have to know that a shift is a Workforce concept and
a session a Treasury one. They stay distinct in the schema (carried item
P1D-A); only the command is unified, and both are written in one transaction.

`Idempotency-Key` is MANDATORY (FR-API-020): opening a drawer is a
financially significant act, and a retry over a flaky link must not produce
a second shift or a second session. The two client ULIDs are independent
duplicate protection beneath it.

post.summary:
Declare the physical cash count — FR-POS-094/096/097 [M].

Within tolerance, this closes the session in the SAME request. Above
tolerance, it freezes the session (`open -> closing`) and the disclosed
figures in THIS response are the first and only legitimate disclosure —
FR-POS-095's blind-count control is that expected cash/variance are
revealed strictly AFTER the count is durably committed, never before.
`POST .../close/finalize` is the ONLY way out of `closing` — there is no
above-tolerance one-request path (a manager PIN entered before this
response exists could not be an informed decision).

enforce, checked here too so a caller cannot probe another employee's
session state without holding the right authority.

Requires BOTH report.view.sales and report.view.financial (AND), held by a single role assignment whose scope COVERS this branch (FR-SEC-004). The Internal-MVP single-active-branch restriction is retired: a tenant may have any number of active branches. Refused (403) if the branch is not active, or if the tenant still holds unreviewed role assignments inherited from the scoped-RBAC migration. A future businessDay is 400, never an all-zeros OPEN report. Cash Reconciliation is WHOLE_SESSION scope and PARTIAL (zero-payment/movement-only sessions are not attributable to a business day and are not listed; no day-level variance/expected/counted/movement total is ever emitted). Tax is broken down by class only, never by rate. Money is a decimal (minor-unit) string on the wire, never a JSON number. tenderTotals.completedExcessCapturedTotal (acceptance correction, 2026-08-31) is captured payment value above a completed order’s grand total — P1F-2 permits paidTotal > grandTotal on completion; this term is reconciliation-only, with no revenue/tax/tip/discount/ refund/rounding/variance disposition inferred, and it makes tenderGrandTotal === grossSales + unsettledCapturedTotal + completedExcessCapturedTotal hold exactly.

post.description: FR-OFF-020..025. Operations are applied in causal order, each with its own failure isolation, and answered individually as accepted, duplicate, conflict, rejected or deferred. Only the first four are DEFINITIVE: a client may remove an operation from its outbox on those and must retain it on anything else, including deferred, a missing result, and any transport failure. Replaying the same batchId with the same body returns the stored response and re-applies nothing.

batchId.description: The batch id the client supplied, echoed unchanged.

clockSkewExceededThreshold.description: True when the skew exceeded the configured threshold (default 5 minutes). The skew is recorded and an alert raised; the operations are still accepted and their original timestamps preserved.

clockSkewMs.description: Largest observed |device HLC physical clock − server receipt|, signed: positive means the device runs AHEAD. Reported, never silently corrected (FR-OFF-042).

replayed.description: True when this batch had already been completed and the stored response was replayed verbatim. Nothing was re-applied (FR-OFF-025).

results.description: One result per submitted operation, in submission order.

conflictId.description: The sync.conflict_records row raised for this operation, when status is conflict.

definitive.description: True exactly when the client may delete this operation from its outbox. Restated as a field so a client never has to hard-code the status vocabulary to decide.

detail.description: Handler-supplied result detail, echoed to the client.

opId.description: The client-generated operation id, echoed back UNCHANGED — FR-OFF-015: the server never reassigns an identifier.

reasonCode.description: Machine-readable reason. Always present on rejected, conflict and deferred, so a client can decide between dead-lettering, fixing and resending, or waiting for a causal parent.

status.description: accepted | duplicate | conflict | rejected are DEFINITIVE — the client may remove the operation from its outbox. deferred is NOT definitive: the causal parent has not been applied, so retain the operation and resend it once the parent is accepted (FR-OFF-022 / FR-OFF-024).

200.description: Per-operation results. Always 200 for a well-formed authorised batch, whatever the individual outcomes.

400.description: Malformed envelope, an unknown field, an unsupported protocolVersion, more than the permitted number of operations, or an oversized batch.

403.description: No terminal-bound session, the terminal is not active, or deviceId does not match the authenticated terminal.

409.description: This batchId was already used for a different body (a client defect), or it is currently being processed by a live owner.

servers.description: Current application root. There is no global path prefix: routes appear here at the exact paths the application serves. Most are unversioned; the Sync routes are versioned under /v1 because their canonical contract requires it, using Nest URI versioning with a VERSION_NEUTRAL default so no other route was moved. Repository-wide /v1 versioning (SRS §26.1) is a Platform decision and is not yet made. No deployment/proxy configuration exists in this repository, so confirm the real deployed base URL with deployment/ops before treating any prefix as authoritative.
